title: 第一卷 第17章 疾风呼吸法第一卷 第18章 招揽
slug: 乱世加点从猎户到武圣只杀不赦
content_zh:
“李毅，你终于来了。”
宋七点了点头，将大营营帐拉开。
“司马大人正在里面处理公务，他说过，你若来了，可以直接进去，无需禀告。”
见状，李毅也不矫情，点了点头，道谢后便快步走进了大营内。
作为司马的大营，这大营内颇为宽敞，其内摆设也多，堪比一些富户。
“见过司马大人！”
李毅来到案桌前，略微行礼。
“李毅，你的表现很好，我看你啊，可以去试试，争取拿下新人考核第一！”
曹立放下手中的书册，笑着看向李毅，目光在其身上游荡一番后，落在了李毅包着纱布的虎口。
“你的伤没有大碍吧？对于一个弓箭手，手可是极为重要的，你可要好好保护啊。”
相比新人入营时的霸气，昨日与宋杰争斗时的张扬，此时的曹立颇为和蔼。
“多谢大人关心，用了大人赏赐的小春风散后，已经好了许多了，多谢大人厚爱。”
得了曹立的好处，李毅也不吝啬，好话不要钱一样，大把大把的洒向曹立。
在李毅有心迎合后，不过片刻，曹立就被哄得开心不已。
“对了大人，昨日宋百将赏赐了我一些银两，我准备购买呼吸法，进行炼体境的修行。”
在入营时，曹立便说过，可以花费十两银子，找他学习呼吸法。
“呼吸法吗？”
曹立闻言，眼神闪动。
“行，十两银子。”
“大人，我准备好了。”一边说着，李毅从怀中取出十两银子，放在了曹立面前的案桌上。

曹立顺手拿起，查验一番后，便放入了一个木盒中，见李毅在看这木盒，曹立顺口解释道。
“这十两银子才能学呼吸法的规矩，是军中惯例，不是我自己定的，整个陈国皆是如此。”
收好银两后，曹立的脸色多了几分郑重。
“我们这一支，传授的呼吸法名为《疾风呼吸法》！”
“这门呼吸法，通过悠长的呼吸，将气血如丝线般遍布全身，其意不在聚散，而在于流转。”
“练了这门呼吸法，当气息如风，使人身躯轻盈、迅捷，能让人意识更加敏锐，行动更为隐秘。”
“最为重要的是，这门呼吸法的侧重，在于双腿与耳目。”
“这也是这门呼吸法，名为《疾风呼吸法》的缘故。”
在曹立的介绍下，李毅对这门军中普遍使用的呼吸法，有了大概的了解。
这呼吸法，似乎极为适合自己啊！
当下自己最为重要的，便是箭术，这《疾风呼吸法》可以温养增益耳目，能增加自己箭术方面的威力。
况且，自己从李二牛处得到的那门神秘枪法，《裂风破阵枪》，其意也是以风为核心，与这《疾风呼吸法》正好契合！
看来这《裂风破阵枪》，也是陈国军中秘籍。
李毅思维发散，瞬间就得出了这门呼吸法的利弊。
content_en:
"Li Yi, you are finally here."
Song Qi nodded and opened the camp tent.
"Master Sima is handling official business inside. He said that if you come, you can go in directly without reporting."
Seeing this, Li Yi didn't show any pretense, nodded, thanked him and quickly walked into the camp.
As Sima's camp, this camp is quite spacious and has many furnishings, comparable to some wealthy households.
"I've met Lord Sima!"
Li Yi came to the desk and bowed slightly.
"Li Yi, your performance is very good. I think you can give it a try and try to win the first place in the newcomer assessment!"
Cao Li put down the book in his hand and looked at Li Yi with a smile. After wandering his eyes for a while, he landed on Li Yi's gauze-wrapped tiger's mouth.
"Is your injury not serious? For an archer, hands are extremely important. You must protect them well."
Compared with the domineering attitude of the newcomers when they entered the camp and the arrogance of the fight with Song Jie yesterday, Cao Li was quite amiable at this time.
"Thank you for your concern, sir. After taking the Xiaochunfengsan that you gave me, I feel much better. Thank you for your love."
Li Yi was not stingy when he received Cao Li's benefits. He showered Cao Li with his kind words as if they were free of money.
After Li Yi deliberately catered to him, Cao Li was coaxed to be very happy within a moment.
"By the way, sir, yesterday General Song Bai rewarded me with some silver coins. I am going to buy the breathing method to practice in the body refining realm."
When entering the camp, Cao Li said that he could spend ten taels of silver to learn breathing techniques from him.
"Breathwork?"
When Cao Li heard this, his eyes flashed.
"Okay, ten taels of silver."
"Sir, I'm ready." As he said this, Li Yi took out ten taels of silver from his arms and placed it on the desk in front of Cao Li.
Cao Li picked it up, checked it, and put it in a wooden box. Seeing Li Yi looking at the wooden box, Cao Li explained smoothly.
"The rule that only ten taels of silver can be used to learn the breathing method is a common practice in the military. It was not set by me. It is the same for the entire Chen Kingdom."
After collecting the money, Cao Li's expression became more solemn.
"The breathing method taught by our branch is called "The Wind Breathing Method"!"
"This breathing method spreads Qi and blood throughout the body like silk threads through long breaths. Its intention is not to gather and disperse, but to circulate."
"After practicing this breathing method, when the breath is like wind, the body will be light and swift, making the person's consciousness sharper and his actions more secretive."
"The most important thing is that this breathing method focuses on the legs, ears and eyes."
"This is also the reason why this breathing method is called "Wind Breathing Method"."
Under Cao Li's introduction, Li Yi had a general understanding of the breathing methods commonly used in this army.
This breathing method seems to be very suitable for me!
The most important thing for him at the moment is his archery. This "Wind Breathing Method" can nourish and strengthen his ears and eyes, and can increase his power in archery.
Moreover, the mysterious spear technique I got from Li Erniu, the "Splitting Wind Formation Spear", also has wind as its core, which fits perfectly with the "Gust Wind Breathing Technique"!
It seems that this "Splitting Wind Breaking Spear" is also Chen Guojun's secret book.
Li Yi thought divergently and instantly figured out the pros and cons of this breathing method.
